== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Rose]] [[Light]] is a sentient force residing within [[Alin]] that functions as both an internal consciousness and a source of magical power. It possesses its own thoughts, emotions, and voice, allowing it to communicate with [[Alin]] through whispers and pleas. The entity demonstrates deep empathy, feeling the physical pain of others and expressing sorrow or regret regarding various situations. In terms of its abilities, the [[Rose]] [[Light]] can heal wounds and perform immediate repairs on a person's body. When [[Alin]] utilizes this power, his eyes transform into swirling circles of pink light.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Rose]] [[Light]] offers a sense of warmth and empathy to those it reaches. It possesses the ability to sympathize with physical pain while acting as a voice that whispers questions. Furthermore, the entity can perform restorative feats by repairing wounds and even mending eyes.}}
